headline: A 2019 executive order added steps to an existing national emergency aimed at major international criminal groups.
what_it_does: The title says this order builds on an existing national emergency about significant criminal groups that operate across national borders. Orders like this usually use emergency powers to impose economic sanctions, such as freezing assets in the US and barring Americans from doing business with listed groups. No summary was provided, so the specific new steps are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Transnational criminal organizations and the people tied to them
who_it_affects.how: They are the target of the national emergency and may face added legal and financial restrictions in the US.
They may have to follow added rules that bar dealings with groups or people the government names under this emergency.
